chip: MODEL OUTPUT · assumptions shown · not a forecast

county_source.table: Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019-2023 (Finnish Cancer Registry/THL/FICAN, publ. 23.4.2026), Taulukko 11
county_source.note: denominator = lung cancer patients diagnosed 2019-2023 (5 diagnosis years); annual volume = N/5 (derived)

scenario.label: Mid what-if + crowding-out of non-alerted patients
scenario.source: Olsson O 2020 (recs/top3.md) for direction; magnitude is ASSUMPTION crowding_extra_days

metric_definitions.pct_le42_from_referral: % of patients with a first active treatment (surgery, non-palliative RT, drug) within 6 months of diagnosis who started it <=42 days after referral arrival [depends on ASSUMPTION ref_to_dx]
metric_definitions.pct_le42_from_diagnosis: % of the same patients who started <=42 days after the Cancer Registry diagnosis date [data-anchored; baseline only]
metric_definitions.median_days_referral_to_treatment: median days referral arrival -> first active treatment [depends on ASSUMPTION ref_to_dx]
metric_definitions.median_days_diagnosis_to_treatment: median days diagnosis -> first active treatment [data-anchored; baseline only]
metric_definitions.n_patients: simulated newly diagnosed lung cancer patients in the year
metric_definitions.n_active_treated: patients with a first active treatment within 6 months
metric_definitions.n_le42_from_referral: patients per year starting first active treatment <=42 days after referral
metric_definitions.n_untreated_at_alert_day: actively treated patients still untreated at day 28 after referral = day-28 alerts per year among them (lower bound on alert volume; baseline only)

interval_note: 2.5-97.5 percentiles across simulated years; combine calibration-posterior, first-event-mix, referral->diagnosis ASSUMPTION, effect and cohort (Poisson) uncertainty.

assumptions.label: ASSUMPTION
assumptions.value: treatment cannot move earlier than the alert day

assumptions.label: ASSUMPTION
assumptions.value: study effect sizes transfer to a Finnish day-28 alert + navigator

caveats: Referral->diagnosis is unpublished in Finland; referral-anchored outputs depend on a labelled ASSUMPTION range (7-35 day median).
County timing is inherited from its collaborative area (no county-level timing is published).
42-day target: THL Ohjaus 21/2016 section 4.1, document marked outdated; no lung-specific limit.
Scenario effect sizes come from other interventions/countries (effect_transfer ASSUMPTION); the zero-effect scenario is always shown.
Diagnosis date equals treatment date for >=25% of surgical patients in 3 areas (Taulukko 4.1 Q1 = 0); short diagnosis-anchored times partly reflect recording.
